_doc: Operator-intended runtime spec, checked against the RUNNING system by
core/invariants.py at every pipeline start and via /api/invariants.
A slot field listed here must match the loaded ModelConfig exactly;
a field omitted here is not checked. Update this file ONLY when the
operator deliberately changes the live setup — the whole point is
that silent divergence between intention and runtime becomes loud.
History that motivated it: tier scale base, slot target_leverage,
exec_* passthrough, missing protocol COPY, MIN_STOCKS_REQUIRED=500.
2026-10-15: combo_v2_process pinned to exec_style "auction" (AUCTION1 measurement, migration 2026-10-auction-v1); the primary and exp slots stay on marketable_limit as same-day controls.
